title: Network health v2.3
description: Per-node network health: latency, reachability, web response and bandwidth vs each node's expected speed.

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "ping" WITH KEY = "computerTag"

list.name: target
list.label: Ping target
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "ping" WITH KEY = "address" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/

panels.title: Internet latency
panels.description: Average ping to internet targets (everything except private/LAN addresses) over the last 15 minutes. Green < 40 ms, orange < 100 ms, red above.

targets.query: SELECT mean("avg") FROM "ping" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND "address" !~ /^(10|127|192\.168|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01]))\./ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "computerTag"

panels.title: Router latency
panels.description: Average ping to the router (private/LAN addresses) over the last 15 minutes. High values here point at the Pi's Wi-Fi or cable, not the ISP. Green < 10 ms, orange < 30 ms.

targets.query: SELECT mean("avg") FROM "ping" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND "address" =~ /^(10|127|192\.168|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01]))\./ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "computerTag"

panels.title: Jitter
panels.description: Ping variation (mdev) to internet targets over the last 15 minutes. Hurts calls and gaming. Green < 10 ms, orange < 30 ms.

targets.query: SELECT mean("mdev") FROM "ping" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND "address" !~ /^(10|127|192\.168|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01]))\./ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "computerTag"

panels.title: Packet loss
panels.description: Average share of lost ping packets over the last 15 minutes, all targets. Any loss is orange, 5 % or more red. A target that answers nothing at all is not here but under Failures (ping exits with an error instead).

targets.query: SELECT mean("packetsPercent") FROM "ping" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "computerTag"

panels.title: Last download
panels.description: Most recent speed test per node (the value), with the last 24 hours of hourly tests as a sparkline. The full circle is 120 % of the node's expected speed. Each node is judged against its own expected speed: pi113 50/50, pi105 6/18, every other node 1000/100 Mbit/s (download/upload). Orange below 80% of it, red below 50%.

targets.query: SELECT mean("download") FROM "speedtest" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "computerTag" fill(none)

panels.title: Last upload
panels.description: Most recent speed test per node (the value), with the last 24 hours of hourly tests as a sparkline. The full circle is 120 % of the node's expected speed. Each node is judged against its own expected speed: pi113 50/50, pi105 6/18, every other node 1000/100 Mbit/s (download/upload). Orange below 80% of it, red below 50%.

targets.query: SELECT mean("upload") FROM "speedtest" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "computerTag" fill(none)

panels.title: Speed tests below expected
panels.description: How many speed tests in the selected time range measured download or upload below 80% of their node's expected speed, all selected nodes. Each node is judged against its own expected speed: pi113 50/50, pi105 6/18, every other node 1000/100 Mbit/s (download/upload). Orange below 80% of it, red below 50%. Details per node in the Bandwidth section.

targets.query: SELECT count("download") FROM "speedtest" WHERE (("computerTag" = 'pi113' AND "download" < 40) OR ("computerTag" = 'pi105' AND "download" < 4.8) OR ("computerTag" !~ /^(pi113|pi105)$/ AND "download" < 800)) AND "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter

SELECT count("upload") FROM "speedtest" WHERE (("computerTag" = 'pi113' AND "upload" < 40) OR ("computerTag" = 'pi105' AND "upload" < 14.4) OR ("computerTag" !~ /^(pi113|pi105)$/ AND "upload" < 80)) AND "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Failures (last hour)
panels.description: Commands that failed outright in the last hour, all selected nodes: ping with no reply at all, curl errors or timeouts (10 s), failed speed tests, and DNS lookups with no answer or a resolver error.

targets.query: SELECT count("count") FROM "pingError" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT count("count") FROM "curlError" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT count("count") FROM "speedtest-error" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT count("count") FROM "dnsError" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Last report per node
panels.description: When each node last wrote a ping result (looks back 7 days, ignores the node filter), and how many curl results it wrote in the last 10 minutes (about 40 when healthy). 0 (red) means the node has stopped reporting.

targets.query: SELECT last("avg") AS "Last ping" FROM "ping" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY "computerTag"
SELECT count("total") AS "Reports in last 10 min" FROM "curl" WHERE time > now() - 10m GROUP BY "computerTag"

panels.title: Internet latency per node
panels.description: Average ping to internet targets. One line per node.

targets.query: SELECT mean("avg") FROM "ping" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND "address" !~ /^(10|127|192\.168|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01]))\./ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "computerTag" fill(null)

panels.title: Router latency per node
panels.description: Average ping to the router. Compare with internet latency on the left: if both rise on one node, that node's Wi-Fi/LAN is the problem; if only internet rises everywhere, it is the ISP.

targets.query: SELECT mean("avg") FROM "ping" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND "address" =~ /^(10|127|192\.168|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01]))\./ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "computerTag" fill(null)

panels.title: Jitter per node
panels.description: Ping variation (mdev) to internet targets.

targets.query: SELECT mean("mdev") FROM "ping" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND "address" !~ /^(10|127|192\.168|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01]))\./ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "computerTag" fill(null)

panels.title: Packet loss per node
panels.description: Share of lost ping packets per 15 minutes, all targets. Total outages are not here (ping fails instead); see the status grid below.

targets.query: SELECT mean("packetsPercent") FROM "ping" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "computerTag" fill(null)

panels.title: Latency by target: $node
panels.description: Average ping per target for one node. Repeated for each selected node.

targets.query: SELECT mean("avg") FROM "ping" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND "address" =~ /^$target$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "address" fill(null)

panels.title: Reachability by node and target: green no loss · orange some loss · red heavy loss · dark red no reply
panels.description: Each cell is the worst packet loss in that time slice. Green: no loss. Orange: some loss. Red: half or more lost. Dark red "no reply": no ping result at all, because the target did not answer or the node itself stopped reporting. Cells are 5 minutes wide at 24 h, so any outage of 5 minutes or more is visible; shorter ones show under Failures over time.

targets.query: SELECT max("packetsPercent") FROM "ping" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND "address" =~ /^$target$/ AND $timeFilter AND time < now() - 2m GROUP BY time($__interval), "computerTag", "address" fill(100)

panels.title: Failures over time
panels.description: Failed commands per time slice, all selected nodes.

targets.query: SELECT count("count") FROM "pingError" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)
SELECT count("count") FROM "curlError" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)
SELECT count("count") FROM "speedtest-error" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)
SELECT count("count") FROM "dnsError" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)

panels.title: Failures per node
panels.description: Failed commands per node in the selected time range. Nodes without failures are not listed.

targets.query: SELECT count("count") AS "Ping" FROM "pingError" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "computerTag"
SELECT count("count") AS "Curl" FROM "curlError" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "computerTag"
SELECT count("count") AS "Speed test" FROM "speedtest-error" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "computerTag"
SELECT count("count") AS "DNS" FROM "dnsError" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "computerTag"

panels.title: Page load time by URL: $node
panels.description: Total time to fetch each URL (DNS + connect + TLS + server + transfer) for one node. Repeated for each selected node.

targets.query: SELECT mean("total") * 1000 FROM "curl" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "address" fill(null)

panels.title: Where page-load time goes
panels.description: Average time per phase of fetching each URL, selected nodes and time range. DNS: name lookup. Connect: TCP. TLS: encryption handshake (≈0 for plain HTTP). Server wait: until the first byte. Transfer: rest of the page. Needs service version with the extended curl timings.

targets.query: SELECT mean("namelookup") * 1000 AS "DNS", (mean("connect") - mean("namelookup")) * 1000 AS "Connect", (mean("pretransfer") - mean("connect")) * 1000 AS "TLS", (mean("starttransfer") - mean("pretransfer")) * 1000 AS "Server wait", (mean("total") - mean("starttransfer")) * 1000 AS "Transfer" FROM "curl" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND "connect" > 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "address"

panels.title: Name lookup time in curl per node
panels.description: Average name-lookup time of the curl requests across URLs. Slow DNS makes everything feel slow even when bandwidth is fine. The DNS row below measures each resolver separately.

targets.query: SELECT mean("namelookup") * 1000 FROM "curl" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "computerTag" fill(null)

panels.title: DNS lookup time: $node
panels.description: Time to answer each DNS query for one node. "system" is the node's normal resolver (what applications use); other resolvers come from the node's DNS_SERVERS setting. "cached" asks for a name every resolver has cached, so it measures the path to the resolver. "uncached" asks for a new random name, so a local resolver (for example a Pi-hole or the router) must ask its upstream server; large public resolvers can still answer it from cache. Repeated for each selected node. Failed lookups are in the Reliability row.

targets.query: SELECT mean("queryTime") FROM "dns" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "resolver", "query" fill(null)

panels.title: DNS per node and resolver
panels.description: DNS lookup times and failures in the selected time range. Median and p95 in ms: green under 100, orange under 1000, red above. A p95 or max near 4000 ms means lookups that timed out once and were answered on the retry. "system" is the node's normal resolver (what applications use); other resolvers come from the node's DNS_SERVERS setting. "cached" asks for a name every resolver has cached, so it measures the path to the resolver. "uncached" asks for a new random name, so a local resolver (for example a Pi-hole or the router) must ask its upstream server; large public resolvers can still answer it from cache.

targets.query: SELECT count("queryTime") AS "Answers", median("queryTime") AS "Median", percentile("queryTime", 95) AS "p95", max("queryTime") AS "Max" FROM "dns" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "computerTag", "resolver", "query"
SELECT count("count") AS "Failures" FROM "dnsError" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "computerTag", "resolver", "query"

panels.title: Download, % of expected per node
panels.description: Speed test results (hourly) as a share of each node's expected download speed, so all nodes compare on one scale. Orange band: below 80%. Red band: below 50%. Each node is judged against its own expected speed: pi113 50/50, pi105 6/18, every other node 1000/100 Mbit/s (download/upload). Orange below 80% of it, red below 50%.

targets.query: SELECT mean("download") / 50 * 100 FROM "speedtest" WHERE "computerTag" = 'pi113' AND "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "computerTag" fill(none)
SELECT mean("download") / 6 * 100 FROM "speedtest" WHERE "computerTag" = 'pi105' AND "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "computerTag" fill(none)
SELECT mean("download") / 1000 * 100 FROM "speedtest" WHERE "computerTag" !~ /^(pi113|pi105)$/ AND "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "computerTag" fill(none)

panels.title: Upload, % of expected per node
panels.description: Speed test results (hourly) as a share of each node's expected upload speed, so all nodes compare on one scale. Orange band: below 80%. Red band: below 50%. Each node is judged against its own expected speed: pi113 50/50, pi105 6/18, every other node 1000/100 Mbit/s (download/upload). Orange below 80% of it, red below 50%.

targets.query: SELECT mean("upload") / 50 * 100 FROM "speedtest" WHERE "computerTag" = 'pi113' AND "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "computerTag" fill(none)
SELECT mean("upload") / 18 * 100 FROM "speedtest" WHERE "computerTag" = 'pi105' AND "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "computerTag" fill(none)
SELECT mean("upload") / 100 * 100 FROM "speedtest" WHERE "computerTag" !~ /^(pi113|pi105)$/ AND "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "computerTag" fill(none)

panels.title: Download per node
panels.description: Speed test results (hourly) in Mbit/s. Each node is judged against its own expected speed: pi113 50/50, pi105 6/18, every other node 1000/100 Mbit/s (download/upload). Orange below 80% of it, red below 50%.

targets.query: SELECT mean("download") FROM "speedtest" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "computerTag" fill(none)

panels.title: Upload per node
panels.description: Speed test results (hourly) in Mbit/s. Each node is judged against its own expected speed: pi113 50/50, pi105 6/18, every other node 1000/100 Mbit/s (download/upload). Orange below 80% of it, red below 50%.

targets.query: SELECT mean("upload") FROM "speedtest" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "computerTag" fill(none)

panels.title: Speed vs expected per node
panels.description: Speed test summary for the selected time range. DL = download, UL = upload. "expected" and "last" are Mbit/s; "avg %" and "min %" are a share of the node's expected speed; "below" counts tests under 80% of it. Each node is judged against its own expected speed: pi113 50/50, pi105 6/18, every other node 1000/100 Mbit/s (download/upload). Orange below 80% of it, red below 50%.

targets.query: SELECT count("download") AS "Tests", 50 + 0 * last("download") AS "DL expected", last("download") AS "DL last", mean("download") / 50 * 100 AS "DL avg %", min("download") / 50 * 100 AS "DL min %", 50 + 0 * last("upload") AS "UL expected", last("upload") AS "UL last", mean("upload") / 50 * 100 AS "UL avg %", min("upload") / 50 * 100 AS "UL min %" FROM "speedtest" WHERE "computerTag" = 'pi113' AND "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "computerTag"

SELECT count("download") AS "Tests", 6 + 0 * last("download") AS "DL expected", last("download") AS "DL last", mean("download") / 6 * 100 AS "DL avg %", min("download") / 6 * 100 AS "DL min %", 18 + 0 * last("upload") AS "UL expected", last("upload") AS "UL last", mean("upload") / 18 * 100 AS "UL avg %", min("upload") / 18 * 100 AS "UL min %" FROM "speedtest" WHERE "computerTag" = 'pi105' AND "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "computerTag"

SELECT count("download") AS "Tests", 1000 + 0 * last("download") AS "DL expected", last("download") AS "DL last", mean("download") / 1000 * 100 AS "DL avg %", min("download") / 1000 * 100 AS "DL min %", 100 + 0 * last("upload") AS "UL expected", last("upload") AS "UL last", mean("upload") / 100 * 100 AS "UL avg %", min("upload") / 100 * 100 AS "UL min %" FROM "speedtest" WHERE "computerTag" !~ /^(pi113|pi105)$/ AND "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "computerTag"

SELECT count("download") AS "DL below" FROM "speedtest" WHERE (("computerTag" = 'pi113' AND "download" < 40) OR ("computerTag" = 'pi105' AND "download" < 4.8) OR ("computerTag" !~ /^(pi113|pi105)$/ AND "download" < 800)) AND "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "computerTag"

SELECT count("upload") AS "UL below" FROM "speedtest" WHERE (("computerTag" = 'pi113' AND "upload" < 40) OR ("computerTag" = 'pi105' AND "upload" < 14.4) OR ("computerTag" !~ /^(pi113|pi105)$/ AND "upload" < 80)) AND "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "computerTag"

panels.title: Speed test ping per node
panels.description: Latency measured by the speed test itself, to its test server. Needs service version with the extended speed test parsing.

targets.query: SELECT mean("ping") FROM "speedtest" WHERE "computerTag" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "computerTag" fill(none)
